name: Choice Consequence
description: The flags a story remembers and the branches they open. A choice sets flags; a link carries a condition over them; and the pair is the entire machinery of a branching narrative. Conditions are declared data rather than embedded code so the same story can be linted — an unreachable branch is a bug an author wants told about before publication, not discovered by a reader who never sees it. Delayed consequences are first-class: a flag may carry a fire-after so a decision in chapter one can land in chapter six, which is the effect the form exists for and the one hardest to hand-roll.

inputs.name: conditions
inputs.description: Named conditions over flags, referenced by passage links. Required.

inputs.name: reportUnreachable
inputs.description: Whether branches no flag combination can open are reported on load.

inputs.name: allowDelayedConsequences
inputs.description: Whether a flag may declare a passage count after which it takes effect.
